name: Durovex Kneecap Pro Knee Pad — Pair
description: Hard-shell knee pads in impact-resistant black polymer with a gel interior cushion and an adjustable nylon strap system. The polymer shell is scuffed and scratched into a dull grey at the contact points. Sold as a pair, worn until the gel compresses flat.
functionality: Hard-shell protects against impact and sharp debris; gel insert distributes pressure across the joint for extended kneeling on concrete or grating.
what_it_says: You've spent enough time on your knees on hard floors that you invested in something to make it survivable.
story_hooks: A worker with prosthetic legs still wears one knee pad — a habit from before, kept for reasons they don't explain.
Durovex's gel formula was quietly reformulated last year; the new version compresses faster, meaning more repeat purchases — a fact a shop steward has documented carefully.
